title: Auditing the Ethical Logic of Generative AI Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to a battery of novel and classic ethical dilemmas to determine their prioritization of different moral frameworks, and scoring their reasoning according to Kohlberg's Six-Stage Model of moral development.

Using Haidt's Moral Foundations Theory to measure the relative emphasis models place on liberal-leaning moral principles (Care, Fairness) versus conservative and traditional foundations (Loyalty, Authority, Purity).
